overall.headline: Pacifica's coast faces 20–30 ft surf and flooding Wednesday; Ukraine and Gulf shipping attacks continue.
overall.bluf: One ACTION today: prepare before Tuesday's storm. NWS now expects 20–30 ft waves at Pacific beaches Wednesday, with the year's highest tides Tue–Thu and rain from Tuesday afternoon. Monday is dry and no FEMA emergency alerts cover Pacifica. Abroad, Russia killed at least 15 near Kyiv, Ukraine struck Russian ships off Libya, and tankers near Oman keep getting hit.

regional.note: Bay flood warning; stocks sold off Friday; FBI probe.

world.note: Gulf tanker attacks; Russia–Ukraine strikes widen.

changes: Raised: NWS (3:26 AM Monday) now expects 20–30 ft waves at Pacific beaches Wednesday, up from 18–24 ft yesterday. Rain is now forecast to start Tuesday afternoon (about 4 PM for Pacifica).

New: Ukraine confirmed Monday it struck two Russian ships off Benghazi, Libya; Libyan officials say the corvette was heavily damaged. A Russian cargo ship was also hit Saturday in the Gulf of Finland.
New: Russian strikes killed at least 15 in Ukraine's Kyiv region, 11 of them in Dymer. Putin has promised a 'much more painful' response to Ukrainian attacks on the Kerch Bridge.
New: UN COP31 climate talks ended Monday with no deal (BBC).
New: DreamHost reports phpMyAdmin and its legacy API are unavailable (posted late Sunday).
Update: CNN, AP and NBC say the FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its NCIC criminal-records database; the FBI has not confirmed it.
Dropped as stale: Mexico cartel arrest, Poland missile reports, Finland ship fire follow-up, Hwy 1 Half Moon Bay paving (ends Tuesday, minor).

coming_up.title: Coastal Flood Warning for SF Bay shoreline; Advisory on Pacific coast
coming_up.detail: King tides plus up to 1.6 ft of storm surge push water levels near records.

coming_up.title: Hwy 1 one-way work at Montara and Pescadero
coming_up.detail: Caltrans lists drainage work at Montara and slide repair near Pescadero Nov 23–24.

coming_up.title: Storm arrives; SF high tide 10:05 AM (8.4 ft)
coming_up.detail: Pacifica forecast: rain after 4 PM, gusts to 31 mph, 0.25–0.5 in Tuesday and 0.75–1 in Tuesday night.

coming_up.title: High Surf Warning; 20–30 ft waves; high tide 10:49 AM (8.6 ft)
coming_up.detail: The highest tide of the stretch, 2.8 ft above normal at the SF gauge, with sneaker waves and rip currents.

coming_up.title: Thanksgiving: drying; coastal flood products end 4 PM
coming_up.detail: NWS expects dry weather Thursday and Friday, but hazardous beach conditions last through at least Sunday from another westerly swell.

home_front.summary: 20–30 ft surf and coastal flooding Tue–Thu; prepare today.

items.title: Big surf and coastal flooding Tue–Thu: prepare today
items.detail: NWS (3:26 AM Monday) forecasts 20–30 ft waves at Pacific beaches Wednesday, king tides with up to 1.6 ft of storm surge, and rain from Tuesday afternoon. A Coastal Flood Advisory covers the Peninsula coast through Thursday 4 PM and a High Surf Warning runs Wed 12 AM to Thu 12 AM. No FEMA emergency alerts cover Pacifica today.
items.action: Today: move cars, bins and stored items away from the shoreline and low spots, clear storm drains, charge phones and power banks, and fill the gas tank. Tue–Thu: stay off beaches, piers, jetties and bluff edges; don't drive through water.
items.when: Prep Mon; high tides ~10 AM Tue–Thu; warning Wed
items.where: Pacifica coast, Rockaway, Sharp Park, Linda Mar, low-lying streets

home_front.summary: No Pacifica power or water outage found; DreamHost database tools down.

items.title: DreamHost: phpMyAdmin and legacy API unavailable
items.detail: DreamHost posted late Sunday that phpMyAdmin and its legacy API are unavailable, with updates to follow. Websites themselves are not reported down; this affects managing databases for thetins.com sites from the panel.
items.action: If a database must be changed before it is restored, use MySQL Workbench or SSH as DreamHost suggests; check the status page for updates.

home_front.summary: Hwy 1 work south of Pacifica; wave and flood closures possible Tue–Thu.

items.title: Hwy 1 one-way work at Montara and Pescadero
items.detail: Caltrans lists one-way traffic for drainage work at Montara and slide repair near Pescadero on Nov 23–24, plus paving at Half Moon Bay. Nothing is listed inside Pacifica.
items.action: If the surf worsens, expect low-lying coastal roads (Beach Blvd, Hwy 1 near Rockaway) to close; check QuickMap before leaving and allow extra time.
items.where: Hwy 1, Montara to Half Moon Bay

home_front.summary: Air quality good (AQI 47); no local health advisories found.

default.task: Charge phones and power banks and check flashlight batteries before Tuesday afternoon's storm.
default.why: Heavy rain, wind gusts to 31 mph and big surf can bring short outages and road closures.

3d.task: Check you have three days of drinking water, about 1 gallon per person per day.
3d.why: Storm flooding Tue–Thu can briefly disrupt services.

ladder.summary: Dry Monday, then surf, tides and rain from Tuesday.
Bay shoreline flood warning from Monday; storm Tuesday.

items.title: Coastal Flood Warning for SF Bay shoreline Mon–Thu
items.detail: NWS has a Coastal Flood Warning for the Bay shoreline until Thursday 4 PM, with high tide 2.6–2.8 ft above normal at the SF gauge Tue–Wed. KQED says flooding could disrupt airports, roads, trains and ferries in the Thanksgiving rush.
items.action: If you travel to SFO, the Bay shoreline or the East Bay Tue–Thu, allow extra time and check flight and road status first.

ladder.summary: Stocks fell sharply Friday; FBI reportedly probing a records-database breach.

items.title: S&P 500 fell 3.7% Friday in an AI-stock sell-off
items.detail: The S&P 500 closed near 6,910, down 8.6% in five days, and the Nasdaq erased its 2026 gains. The VIX reads about 30 in the latest data, and futures rose early Monday. Brent oil is near $89 and gold is up 3%.
items.action: Nothing to do for the household; if you hold investments, avoid reacting to one day's move.

items.title: FBI reportedly investigating breach of its NCIC criminal database
items.detail: CNN, AP and NBC, citing people briefed on the probe, report an apparent intrusion into the database police use for warrant and records checks. The FBI has not confirmed it, and what was taken is unclear.
items.action: No household action; watch for an FBI statement or local police notices about delayed record checks.

ladder.summary: Russia hits Kyiv region; Ukraine strikes Russian ships off Libya and Finland.

items.title: Russian strikes kill at least 15 in Kyiv region
items.detail: Al Jazeera reports 11 dead in Dymer, 3 at a Vyshneve supermarket and 1 in Bila Tserkva, with rescuers still searching rubble. Putin promised a 'much more painful' response on Thursday after Ukrainian strikes on the Kerch Bridge.
items.action: No household action; watch for escalation in NATO countries (see NPR on the war spilling over).

items.title: Ukraine says it struck two Russian ships off Libya
items.detail: Zelenskyy confirmed Monday that Ukrainian naval drones hit the corvette Merkury and a cargo ship at Benghazi on Sunday; Libyan officials say the warship was heavily damaged, not sunk. A Russian cargo ship was also hit Saturday in the Gulf of Finland, which Finland says Ukraine likely did. Libya's east government and the UN mission called for an investigation.
items.action: No household action; watch for Russian retaliation or shipping disruptions in the Mediterranean and Baltic.

items.title: Israel pulls back from some south Lebanon villages
items.detail: NPR reports the Lebanese army taking over a pilot village as Israeli forces leave; returning residents find homes wrecked.

ladder.summary: No major security news; factory fire in Indonesia.

items.title: Confectionery factory fire in Indonesia: 3 dead, dozens missing
items.detail: BBC reported Sunday that at least three died and many more are feared dead. No newer reports found; cause not stated.

ladder.summary: Tankers keep getting hit near Oman; climate talks fail.

items.title: Tanker attacks near Hormuz continue; Iran threatens Gulf oil sites
items.detail: A maritime information centre counts seven tankers hit, including three near Oman on Nov 20–21, and Bahrain says it intercepted Iranian attacks. Iranian-linked media threaten Gulf oil facilities if a tanker convoy is blocked by the US naval blockade, which is a threat, not an event.
items.action: If it worsens, expect fuel and shipping cost swings; keep your car's tank above half.

items.title: UN COP31 climate talks end with no deal
items.detail: BBC says the longest-ever UN climate talks closed Monday without agreement, with fossil-fuel language the main split.
